== Summary ==
Slip “•Mapuzo: Underground Corridor” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (768, 620, 1455, 1169)). Version [[Mapuzo: Underground Corridor|Mapuzo: Underground Corridor (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
